world: Assessment of client account qualifications and product program eligibility across commercial partners.

m_c5de: A monthly software spend of $60,000 combined with an 18-month active contract satisfies the requirements of a $50,000 spend and a contract exceeding 12 months.
m_3f2d: Holding premier enterprise account status satisfies the single requirement for priority support routing.
m_c4d7: Qualifying for priority support routing alongside having two certified security officers meets both necessary criteria for enterprise security compliance.
m_5302: Meeting enterprise security compliance criteria together with submitting executive board authorization fulfills the Platinum Partner status requirements.
m_4b85: Fulfilling Platinum Partner status requirements justifies granting access to the Platinum Partner program benefits.
